title: centaurea boissieri subsp. pinae
intro: Centaurea boissieri subsp. pinae, commonly known as a plant species in the Asteraceae family, is a type of thistle that is native to the island of Crete. This plant is valued for its potential health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions of Centaurea boissieri subsp. pinae are attributed to its ability to modulate the immune system and exhibit antimicrobial and hepatoprotective effects. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and sesquiterpene lactones, which may contribute to its medicinal properties.
